anchor.statement: Corollary B.10. The analytic axis profile of Proposition B.2 admits a smooth continuation with E > 0 for X > 0, matching the reference outer radial profile at log(X/X R ) = −5, with exact fields, pressure, and radial moment functions. It has vanishing leading residual stress through X 0 , followed by an inner collar on which the profile remains analytic in η and satisfies the admissible stress cone condition, with the flat factor (B.30). It satisfies the strict inequalities of the relaxed cone condition thereafter up to the matching point. Its finite parameters can be chosen in the order (B.40).
